answer: The beacon counter is kept in whisper and timber exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 18 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. An attacker as a result has to keep each duplicate self continuously active for 18 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 390 aliases cost 322 times the single-account price. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
